allowed_statuses.title: Claim statuses that allow restocking
allowed_statuses.description: Only once the item is physically back: restocking earlier puts stock on sale that is not on the shelf.

target.title: Where restocked units go
target.description: inventory_event: publish inventory.changed@1 with the new on-hand quantity (known from the inventory.changed@1 events of your stock system); record: only record the decision for your own stock process.
